source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

parts.target: Up to 2 **WAR DOG** units of yours, or a **TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit of yours.
parts.effect: Whenever any model of those units makes a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)**, **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** or **[charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)**, the model can pass over models and terrain features, for the rest of the phase. While doing so, it can cross the [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of those models, but it must end the move outside it unless the move is a charge move, and it passes any [Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape) automatically. **[Super-heavy Walker](vsdata:core-ability/super-heavy-walker)** does not apply while this Stratagem is in use.

data.summary:

**Target:** Up to 2 **WAR DOG** units of yours, or a **TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit of yours.

**Effect:** Whenever any model of those units makes a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)**, **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** or **[charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)**, the model can pass over models and terrain features, for the rest of the phase. While doing so, it can cross the [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of those models, but it must end the move outside it unless the move is a charge move, and it passes any [Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape) automatically. **[Super-heavy Walker](vsdata:core-ability/super-heavy-walker)** does not apply while this Stratagem is in use.
